supersedes.reason: Published mcp_registry_enumeration_complete: true after reading 2 pages. The original bytes remain at this revision and still say true; the correction is a new revision beside them, not an edit.

finding.summary: Worked example of a correction. Our own dataset declared a complete enumeration of the MCP registry from a 2-page, 100-entry read. The claim is re-tested, found false, and superseded; the producer is fixed so that the same input now fails closed.

claim.statement: The read behind mcp_registry_unique_entries = 100 enumerated the whole MCP registry (mcp_registry_enumeration_complete = true).
claim.scope: Whether the 14 Sep 2026 read was complete. Not the size of the registry in (name, version) pairs, which is carried as a separate UNMEASURED record.

test.method_id: census/frame.py registry walk with fail-closed read_state
test.procedure: Walk the registry list endpoint with version=latest until nextCursor is absent; count a response as a page only if HTTP 200, complete JSON, servers[] and metadata{} are present; any other response stops the walk as PARTIAL.
substitutions: registry: the 14 Sep registry state was not preserved and cannot be replayed; the 25 Sep state was read instead
collector-v1: kept no response bodies, so whether page 2 was an error object or an empty page cannot be recovered
declared_failure_modes: A registry that returns a well-formed page without nextCursor before its real end would still read as EXHAUSTED; the frame cannot detect a truncating upstream.

negative_control.description: The published legacy totals document, which carries no read_state, is fed to the fixed gate walk_read_state(); it must come back PARTIAL. An error object in place of a page must end the walk as PARTIAL, not as the end of the registry (test_frame.py CensusReadState and RegistryWalk.test_error_object_is_not_an_end).

result.reason: The fixed walk read 359 pages, every one valid, to an upstream end: 35,873 latest-version servers (read_state EXHAUSTED). A 2-page, 100-entry read was therefore not complete. No ratio is stated because the published figure counted (name, version) pairs and the new figure counts latest-version servers.

remediation.reference: Collector and builder fixed to fail closed (census-frame lane); dataset corrected at HF revision fdb15f00ecda72e11e2aee35037a577a3dedbf6f. Republishing the dataset from the fixed builder has not happened, so the state is APPLIED, not VERIFIED_BY_RETEST.

limits: This record says a published completeness claim was false. It says nothing about the quality of any listed server.
The correction is carried by Hugging Face git revisions and a correction note; neither this record nor the correction note is board-signed.
The 14 Sep failure cannot be replayed; the finding rests on a later re-execution against a registry that has grown since.
